summary: A 1970 updated distribution list for the group's notes, listing who should receive them. It was updated by RFC 69.

plainLanguage.summary: This memo lists people who should receive one copy of a document and gives their mailing details. It asks recipients to correct addresses that are no longer current.

questions: who received copies of network documents

subtitle: A revised list of people and addresses for receiving network documents.

tldr.problem: The authors needed an updated distribution list for sending one copy of a document to each recipient.
tldr.mechanism: The note names the recipients and gives the latest postal addresses available to the authors, asking readers to correct them.
tldr.outcome: RFC 52 is an administrative list dated 1 July 1970 and was updated by RFC 69.

today: RFC 52 was updated by RFC 69. Its status is listed as Unknown in the unit metadata.

sections.title: The Distribution List
sections.content:
RFC 52 states that one copy should be sent from the author's site to each person on its list. It names recipients from MIT, MERIT, SDC, SRI, Utah, MITRE, Carnegie-Mellon, RAND, BB&N, Harvard and other organizations.

The note then gives the most current addresses the authors had and asks readers to correct them as necessary.
sections.plainLanguage: The memo tells the authors where to send one copy. It also asks readers to fix any address that is out of date.

sections.title: Recipient Contact Details
sections.content: The list includes names and organizations, followed by postal addresses and telephone numbers. Some entries include telephone extensions. These details are presented as the authors' current information, not as a protocol or a technical standard.
sections.plainLanguage: Each entry gives a person's organization and contact information. The list is for document distribution, not computer communication.

sections.title: Revision and Later Update
sections.content: The header marks the list as revised and dates it 1 July 1970. The unit metadata records RFC 69 as an update to this memo.
sections.plainLanguage: This is a revised version of a distribution list. RFC 69 later updated it.
